summary.text: Tim Bearden was elected to represent Georgia Senate District 30 in February 2024; before that he was the state representative for House District 68 and chaired the House Public Safety and Homeland Security committee.

paragraphs.text: He began his career in law enforcement with the Villa Rica Police Department and rose to sergeant in the motorcycle division of the Douglasville Police Department.
He was executive director of the Georgia Public Safety Training Center, appointed by Gov. Nathan Deal, and later worked as deputy chief of staff for the Speaker of the House.
He has lived in West Georgia since moving to Haralson County in 1975 and now lives in Carrollton.
